run: tools/tutorials/verify_release_candidate.py --live-mobile https://einarolafsson.github.io/spacr/nightly/tutorials/ (three batches of 29/29/27 lessons; a single 85-lesson run died at lesson 58 from a Playwright driver EPIPE, not an assertion)
tap_note: In headless Chrome with phone emulation, a touch on the native <video controls> element (it is the element under the centre point) shows the controls but does not start playback, in all 85 lessons and in a separate two-tap probe of lesson 01. Playback was therefore started with video.play(), the call the native play button makes; narration then advanced and stayed within 0.5 s of the picture after a chapter seek. A touch test on a real phone is still a manual check.
